Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

Brujas_Talent_05_Desc_02:
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."
HugoVlad_Talent_06_Desc_01: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> also triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.
Jufufu_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"
Item_Weapon_S_1361_Desc:
Her life was one of seeking. Seeking companions, enemies, the truth, warmth. She reached out time and again, only to have it slip through her fingers. If one day she finds the missing fragments of her incomplete soul, will she be able to hear the melody in the wind once more?

<color=#959595>"Target has returned to the second floor of the video store. It sounds like they're preparing to sleep. Update on their location has been filed." — Trigger, apparently tracking and documenting a particular target.</color>
Summer_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Characters in the <color=#FFFFFF>Angelic Chord-ination</color> state gain increased ATK, equal to <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>705</color> ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 2,350, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> to the target for 12s. While Sunna is on-field, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>320%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, only the primary attack target's <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered. Upon triggering, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is significantly reduced.

This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>85</color>.
Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.

Yidhari_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.

Burnice_UniqueSkill_06_Desc:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>320%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.

Evelyn_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: Upon entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>14.6%</color>. After leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form</color>.
Seed_Talent_04_Desc_02:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."
Unagi_Skill_ChargeAttack_Desc:
With at least 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or when <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>. She then exits <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Yanagi_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"Yanagi can handle any unfamiliar environment thrown her way."
"I believe in her more than I believe in myself."
— From a martial artist practicing "the cutting of fallen leaves."
Tsubaki_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!

Weapon_TalentDes_81412203:
The equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> hit enemies suffering an Attribute Anomaly, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>95</color> for 15s.
When the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is greater than or equal to 375, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG inflicted by the equipper increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
Brujas_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.
Yuzuha_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:7+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*1.5,1,2}</color> Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Unagi_Talent_05_Desc_02:
The girl arrives at that all too familiar place with flowers, her breath misting and then vanishing into the cold air.
Her fingers ghost over that name on the monument.
Everything is quiet, like that most silence observer.
Yanagi_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"Having the clarity to see your enemy's weakness is like an extra safety net... and it increases your chances at victory."
Yanagi adjusts her glasses, remaining as composed as ever, even when victory is already assured.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1311:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.

Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>350</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>350</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>16.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
Summer_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"That kid's an odd one, always humming strange songs alone in the corner..."
Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.
Then, one warm and gentle afternoon, a dark-haired girl stretched her hand out like an angel.
Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.
Seth_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color>, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
HugoVlad_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81311502: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>2.8%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Lucy_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a <color=#FFFFFF>Line Drive</color>. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a <color=#FFFFFF>Fly Ball</color>. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Summer_Skill_QTE_Title: Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat
Weapon_TalentDes_81300805: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>48</color>, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Lucia_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
This Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Lycaon_Talent_02_Desc_01: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81312803:
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, one of three possible effects is randomly triggered for 5 seconds. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. The same types of effects cannot stack. Repeated triggers reset the duration, allowing several effects to be active at once:
Increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>10.4%</color>, increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>52</color>, or increases the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>.
OokumaMari_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or her enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, quickly use a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
Partner_Impression_f_1181: Is it just me... or does Grace sound just like a human talking to a cat whenever she's talking to machines?
Unagi_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Miyabi has loved reciting poems about the cold since she was a child. She might not understand them completely, but she still does it every day.
Before long, she came to realize their true meaning.
She found clarity not on a still and snowy night, but rather upon the battlefield.
JaneDoe_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Jane directly enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state upon activating the skill, and gains max <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lucia_Skill_AssaultAid_Title: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
Weapon_TalentDes_81310601: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.45</color>/s. When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>, stacking up to 15 times and lasting 1s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Item_Weapon_S_1141_Desc:
This special W-Engine has the capability to create extreme low temperatures. Its radiator opening was designed with an eerie animal teeth decoration and often drips condensation. After Lycaon's improvements, its rough appearance has become much more refined and elegant, and the opening is now utilized to store envelopes and other keepsakes.

<color=#959595>"Manners aren't a leash for wildness; it enhances it before it's set free." — Lycaon, speaking gently during a tea party</color>
Pulchra_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
<color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's</color> DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2.
<color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Business Partner</color>'s <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect now also applies to all damage types, not just <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
Lucy_Talent_05_Desc_02:
She speaks politely to opponents screaming under her bat.
She apologizes to enemies groveling at her feet.
This is the perfect etiquette of a noble lady.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1481:
Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Center, though few know her other identity — a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.
Lighter_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a powerful uppercut, leaping into the air and dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During the move, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up attack, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
After using the move, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to transition to the 4th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
During the shuffle dodge, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Perform a powerful combo punch forward, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Using this skill will not break the combo count for <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the attack, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately transition into the 5th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Summer_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
Characters in the <color=#FFFFFF>Angelic Chord-ination</color> state gain increased ATK, equal to <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>795</color> ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 2,650, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> to the target for 12s. While Sunna is on-field, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>225%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to <color=#2BAD00>360%</color> of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>120%</color>.
DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, only the primary attack target's <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered. Upon triggering, <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is significantly reduced.
Seth_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
Alice_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Alice triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> is enhanced.
Partner_Impression_f_1301:
Orphie has a great personality — being around her really puts you at ease!
But her obliviousness has caused Magus a fair share of grief, and she seems totally unaware of it...
Lisa_Talent_04_Desc_01: When Grace uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks). When her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Quick Inspection</color> hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.
Anton_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"Find your rhythm, and let's get moving!"
When Anton starts to get serious, everyone becomes more nimble.
They have to keep up or else they will be training alone the next day.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414311: The equipper's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1091:
Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.
Norano_Talent_06_Desc_01: When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits an enemy, Manato's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Weapon_TalentDes_81400202: Whenever the equipper's attack triggers an Attribute Counter effect, all units' CRIT Rate against the struck enemy increases by <color=#2BAD00>13.5%</color> for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Trigger_Talent_01_Desc_01: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.
Yuzuha_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The girl I saw through the narrow vent shone like she'd stepped right out of a fairytale.
She was the real princess — and I was just a prisoner.
Lord, she has so much already... would it be so wrong if I had just a tiny bit of it too?
That's when the hairpin silently fell.
Anton_Skill_ExQTE_Title: Ultimate: Go Go Go Go Go!
Lucia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.
Weapon_TalentDes_81314403: The equipper's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>19.5%</color>. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>19.5%</color> for 5s.
Clara_Talent_06_Desc_01: Increases the duration limit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> by 2s and extends the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color> by 4s.
HugoVlad_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301605: When a squad member's HP is greater than or equal to 50%, they take <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> less DMG, and <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> less Miasma Contamination. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Jufufu_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color> centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> effect: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%/40%</color>.
The <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>50</color>.

Enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Celestial Overture</color> accumulates 25% more <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>.
Yuzuha_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon a successful parry, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81411005:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.2</color>/s.
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Item_Weapon_A_Common_05_Desc: This high-power W-Engine boasts a cutting-edge energy conversion device that collects heat from its surroundings and supplies it to the steamer, making it easy for the operator to cook or heat up objects. This makes it a perfect choice for Hollow explorers. However... please be careful when using it to avoid burns.
Lucia_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Cissia_Talent_05_Desc_02: Memories scorched by blinding light, crimes spelled out in black and white... those "marks" were once all that defined me. But things are different now. I've learned to read, and I've learned to recognize the smell of a lie. When that familiar scent of a scheme creeps in again, I won't just walk into the cage like an idiot. This time, I'll be the one leaving "marks" — with my teeth, and I won't hold back.
Ben_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.
Item_Weapon_B_Common_03_Desc: This high-capacity portable W-Engine can collect dissipated energy from its surroundings, thus enhancing the combat effectiveness of its operator. It is a perfect choice for novice explorers who are worried that their W-Engine may run out of power during expeditions.
Nostradamus_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to dodge, then hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to reload while dodging, enhancing <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> up to 8 times.
Astra_Talent_03_Desc_02:
A blank musical staff is a set of parallel lines that never intersect, like souls that have never met, quietly waiting for their melodies to intertwine into a song.
"Let's fill it with notes! And lots and lots of tied notes. It'll make a fantastic song!"
And that's how a new song was created, stretching across 136 bars, all connected with ties...
Evelyn_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.
Corin_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When the equipper activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> or extends its duration, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> increased DMG and <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> increased Max HP for 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Nostradamus_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: When Nicole uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
Tsubaki_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Nekomata launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
Harumasa_Talent_01_Desc_01: The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.
Astra_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
HugoVlad_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"Family is an everlasting, unavoidable curse placed upon a person."
"No matter how much you grow, no matter where you go, that curse will forever follow you like a shadow."
"When you fall to rock bottom or climb to your peak, it will appear, turning you back into that helpless, powerless child who can do nothing but hide in the closet and weep."

"Unless you truly see him, embrace him."
Some pain can only be healed when it is seen and accepted.
Harumasa_Skill_AimAttack_Desc:
After the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, or a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Immediately shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to aim at a target and release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Zhenzhen_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:

The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.

Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>26%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15.5%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>19%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
QingYi_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, it applies 5 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>2.7</color>%. For each rush attack performed during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {CAL:5+5,1,2} stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> are reset.
NangongYu_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Caesar_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"I used to keep my eyes straight ahead, thinking that as long as I was strong enough, I could do anything."
"But being a great leader takes more than just power."
"I need to protect my friends behind me — they are the reason I can keep going."
Item_Weapon_B_Common_09_Desc: This inverter W-Engine can generate excessive power and effectively increase its operator's battle prowess. However, due to its poor heat dissipation, it emits ear-splitting noise during battle. As a result, all squad members will need to wear earplugs.
Caesar_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When Caesar activates <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Parry Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, she buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>500%</color> of her base Impact + <color=#2BAD00>400</color>. The shield lasts for 60s and is equipped by the active character, with its value shared among all squad members. Any single instance of DMG will not exceed the shield value.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, the shield bearer's Anti-Interrupt level is increased.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, the shield bearer's ATK is increased by <color=#2BAD00>135</color>. After <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> expires, this buff remains for an additional 5s.
Ellen_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A rapid dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, Ellen gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> effect, reducing the charge time of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, lasting up to 5 seconds or until it triggers.
Harumasa_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks.
When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.
JaneDoe_Talent_04_Desc_01: When any squad member triggers the <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300502: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>2.3%</color>, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
JaneDoe_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"
Tsubaki_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign: When Nekomata launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her CRIT DMG increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect expires when she's no longer in-combat. This effect gains maximum stacks immediately on defeating an enemy.
Aria_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>75</color>.
If Aria's 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>22.9%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>11.9%</color>/<color=#FF5521>29.8%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>2.08%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>3%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>1.2</color> per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
Ben_Talent_01_Desc_01: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.
Rina_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Summer_Talent_04_Desc_02:
From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.
Weapon_TalentDes_81412003: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>52%</color>. When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly or Stuns an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> for 15s.
Evelyn_Talent_02_Desc_01: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
Evelyn_UniqueSkill_05_Desc: Upon entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20.8%</color>. After leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form</color>.
Yuzuha_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color> upon activation.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Item_Weapon_S_1341_Desc:
100% cold, and 120% sweet. The maker says it's his best custom W-Engine of the year. "So, Miss Zhao, what do you think? I've named this one 'Full-Sugar Bunny.' Fits your style, right? Huh? Change it to Half-Sugar? But why...? Ah, no no, you're the client, you get to name it however you like!"

<color=#959595>"Equivalent exchange means finding a balance — not a bit more, not a bit less." —That was Xiao'Zhao's answer after Dialyn asked her several times, "What's wrong with full-sugar?"</color>
JaneDoe_Talent_06_Desc_02:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."
Jufufu_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"
Rina_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.
Weapon_TalentDes_81413015: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>. When the equipper triggers an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, their attacks ignore <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> of the target's DEF for 8s. Can stack once every 3s, up to 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Longinus_Skill_QTE_Upgrade01_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Slashes enemies in a small area ahead, then executes a powerful upwards slash, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> are guaranteed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> for up to 30s or 8 times.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Soldier 11 enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Alert Stance</color> after using this skill. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Alert Stance</color>, if hit during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fire Charge</color> to block the attack, followed by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fire Assault</color>. After <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fire Assault</color> is performed, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to resume <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> from the retained Basic Attack hit count.
Ben_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.

Weapon_TalentDes_81413605: When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> hits an enemy, causing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> for 5s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack. When this effect is triggered, if the equipper is not the active character, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color>, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. This can trigger only once per use of a skill. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color> increases the equipper's Impact by <color=#2BAD00>6.4%</color>, lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. At full stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color>, the equipper's Impact increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>12.8%</color>.
Unagi_Property_ChargeAttack_Desc_Dmg_01: Charge Level One Slash DMG Multiplier
Item_Weapon_A_Common_19_Desc: Countless threads of Sword Will pulse like heartbeats, echoing through this tiny stretch of sky. Just don't get too close and don't try to make sense of the world inside the cauldron with your own ears. Those echoes have already been twisted into the brain-melting chant of "Ehn-ne ehn-ne."
Jufufu_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
Lucia_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
This Quick Assist is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jufufu_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"
Harumasa_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, up to a max of 7 stacks.
While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color>, the DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by 50%.
Consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Blitz</color> once <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> ends.
Caesar_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Once Caesar recognizes someone as one of her own, she fully accepts them as part of her inner circle. She gives them absolute trust, letting her guard down completely...
Just like she does with you now.
BanYue_Skill_Normal_FinalAttack_Desc:
When Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this move, Banyue exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Astra_Skill_Normal_Singing_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Brujas_Skill_QTE_01_Desc:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
NangongYu_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Aokaku_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill can be triggered consecutively by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> while using this skill allows for a quick transition to <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>.
YiXuan_Skill_Exsp_01_Desc_Dmg_01: Additional DMG Multiplier on Full Charge
EquipmentSuit_33300_4_des: Increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> DMG by 20%. When equipped by an Attack character, using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> will further increase <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> DMG by 20% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
SPBilly_Skill_Evade_02_Desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Bike Mode]</color> Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>[Perfect Dodge]</color>; holding the button will continue drifting, but subsequent <color=#FFFFFF>[Perfect Dodge]</color> cannot be triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414512: The equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.46</color>/s. When the equipper activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> or extends its duration, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>28.8%</color> increased DMG and <color=#2BAD00>17.3%</color> increased Max HP for 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Ellen_Skill_Dash_Slash_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissors strike, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when the Charged Scissors strike hits. If the enemy is <color=#98EFF0>Frozen</color>, it always triggers <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Zhenzhen_Skill_ExQTE_P1_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> while also gaining 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. This skill deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> while in this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301602: When a squad member's HP is greater than or equal to 50%, they take <color=#2BAD00>8.6%</color> less DMG, and <color=#2BAD00>11.5%</color> less Miasma Contamination. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Unagi_Talent_01_Desc_01: While in <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>, every 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> consumed will allow <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> ends. When the slash for charge level three of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>, it will immediately remove the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81415112: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>103</color>. When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, all squad members' DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger once per use of a skill and repeated triggers reset the duration. With 2 stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>69</color>. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Item_Weapon_S_1191_Desc:
This high-power W-Engine has the capability to rapidly lower the temperature of the environment, allowing it to instantly freeze nearby objects. Although it is an excellent tactical W-Engine due to its efficient freezing and high damage output, Ellen primarily uses it to make frappes.

<color=#959595>"I want to bring it to school, especially in the summer. But Lycaon and Rina won't let me... So annoying." — Ellen, shaking her head while eating ice</color>
Burnice_Skill_Special_Title: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
XiaoZhao_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"Don't let that cute face fool you! I'll never forget that meeting — right there in front of a few dozen people, she pointed her finger and, with the sweetest expression, delivered the coldest verdict: 'If your company refuses any single item in this rectification list, you will be removed from TOPS. This isn't a threat — it's the objectively correct conclusion.' That image is forever etched in my mind! ...Still, I have to thank Miss Zhao."
—A company manager who revived his business after a brutal restructuring, speaking with a conflicted look as he rubbed his temples.
Item_Weapon_S_1211_Desc:
A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It contains a special Ether charging layer that can quickly recharge special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. Even though this W-Engine looks like a cruel confinement chamber, Rina's Bangboo seem to enjoy sneaking in there to recharge their batteries. They even treat resting inside as a cozy reward.

<color=#959595>"Shhh... The two little ones are resting; if they're woken suddenly they'll be sure to cause a ruckus. Let's avoid making any noise while we enjoy our tea." — Rina, giving a gentle reminder as she serves tea to friends</color>
Lycaon_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hold down <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81400303: The equipper gains 1 Charge stack every 3s, stacking up to 6 times. When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, consumes all Charge stacks and each stack consumed increases the skill's Daze inflicted by <color=#2BAD00>5.2%</color>.
Rina_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Nostradamus_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Mechanical Case's</color> debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Ellen_Skill_Dash_Slash_Upgrade_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is <color=#98EFF0>Frozen</color>, it always triggers <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
YiXuan_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"Fate is ever-changing and the path ahead uncertain. Only a pure, peaceful spirit holds firm. Even through the tides of time, I harbor no regrets."
"The mystic arts take a thousand forms, yet its core stays the same; the road may fork and falter, but the spirit stays steadfast."
"No matter the peril you face or the foe you meet, improvise as needed and face them with composure."
Ben_Talent_06_Desc_01: After launching an attack or follow-up attack during Ben's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Daze inflicted by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> is increased by 20%, lasting 12s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81312705: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.64</color>/s. The Anomaly Buildup of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> increase by <color=#2BAD00>55%</color>.
Item_Weapon_S_1181_Desc:
Embedded with a supercomputer core, this latest-model W-Engine can compile operating code for machines at an astonishing speed, or quickly collect battlefield data to provide support for the whole squad. Of course, for Grace, this W-Engine is just a little toy for her to communicate with her "silicon-based children."

<color=#959595>"Looking carefully... you're handsome in your own way! Oh, it says in the manual that once it's sealed, it shouldn't be opened... Hmmm... Well, how would we know if we don't give it a try?!" — Grace, suddenly enthusiastic while holding the engine in her hand</color>
Anton_Skill_BeHitAid_Enhance_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Attacks enemies in front with a <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color>, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slashes enemies nearby, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains <color=#2BAD00>2</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Rina_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + <color=#2BAD00>9%</color>, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.
OokumaMari_Talent_02_Desc_01: When Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.

In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> while rapidly consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> until none remains.
The skill ends early if <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is insufficient or if <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.

Norano_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
Max HP increases by 8%.
During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color>, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1511:
Nangong Yu, the captain and choreographer of the idol group the "Angels of Delusion," is a rare prodigy blessed with exceptional Ether aptitude, a sharp business acumen, and outstanding idol talent.

Though she always presents herself with a laid-back air — teasing her teammates and joking around — she consistently receives the fewest negative reviews in the group. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed," she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Nangong possesses a rare gift for making the difficult look effortless — whether it's dancing, rapping, making investments, or reading people. That gift once served as the mask that allowed her to easily play the role of "captain," yet it also kept her isolated from her true desires.

Yet whether it started as responsibility toward a close friend or later turned into an irreplaceable love for the stage, beneath the stage lights and the audience's gaze she has already forged those borrowed sparks into a light of her own.
Weapon_TalentDes_81412102: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.75</color>/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Astra_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, and when Astra Yao expends Energy to release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.
Nostradamus_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
NangongYu_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze.
When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>. When hit by the heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, they gain 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>. When hit by the heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color>, they gain 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> stacks are cleared. When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> is cleared, if the enemy is under an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>800%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>400%</color>/<color=#FF5521>1,000%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>70%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>100%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>50%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%.
<color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato: Modified</color> cannot stack with <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
OokumaMari_Talent_06_Desc_01: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
Aria_Skill_ChargeAttack_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If there is <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color>, with each absorbed <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>'s <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup</color> by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweet Melody</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if there are at least 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> and quickly activate a level three charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color>. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.
NangongYu_Talent_02_Desc_01: Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>'s additional <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio increase from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Prodigious Idol</color> increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Angel Captain</color> increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG. "Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."

Yidhari_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>82%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
