Zhenzhen_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."

"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300403: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>15.6%</color> for 12s.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1431:
Ye Shunguang is the Sword Keeper of Yunkui Summit's treasured Qingming Sword, a disciple of Yixuan, and the younger sister of Ye Shiyuan, as well as a swordswoman blessed with extraordinary talent.
She enjoyed a happy childhood until the fall of the old capital, when her parents lost their lives rescuing others, bringing all her happiness to an abrupt end.
From then on, she relied solely on her brother — up until Yixuan took them in, bringing them into Yunkui Summit. Later, she was chosen by the Qingming Sword, taking up the mantle and duty of Sword Keeper.

Rumor has it that the Qingming Sword's favor is less a blessing and more a kind of curse. Though it gives its Sword Keeper Void Hunter level power, it extracts a harsh cost — the loss of one's memories and five senses.
In order to subdue this side effect, Yixuan Shifu crafted a custom sword case for Ye Shunguang. It appears effective for the moment, but the true nature of the weapon is still shrouded in mystery.
Weapon_TalentDes_81314402: The equipper's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>17.25%</color>. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>17.25%</color> for 5s.

YiXuan_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Weapon_TalentDes_81201101: Accumulating Anomaly Buildup increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
Partner_Impression_f_1011:
Anby often comes to the video store to borrow movies and returns them quickly, so she seems to watch a lot of movies.
Feelin' the pressure, bro? As the manager of the video rental store, it'd be embarrassing if the amount of movies we watch falls behind our customers.
Anbi_Skill_Special_Desc:

HugoVlad_Talent_01_Desc_01: When triggering the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.
Yuzuha_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"...The princess led a busy life. At sunrise, her silent and stoic maids would adorn her with lavish garments, a weighty magical crown, and layers of jewelry before guiding her to the throne where she used her powers to turn mundane stones into priceless gems."
"Does the princess really have to turn stones into gems every single day? That sounds even more boring than doing homework while minding the shop."
"Well... if she doesn't, the poor kingdom will collapse."
"If a kingdom can only survive by overworking the princess, then let it collapse!"
She bursts into laughter. Yes — let such a useless kingdom fall.
Item_Weapon_S_1391_Desc:
Goodbye to the fate of the past, goodbye to the childhood that slipped away so quickly, goodbye to my father's embrace and my mother's smile, goodbye to the claws and the stripes, goodbye to the unmoving mountains and the clouds that never linger, goodbye to my mentor and old friends, goodbye to me, goodbye to me.
As long as the world remembers, I once roared with courage.

<color=#959595>"Never fear! Your senior is here!" —  Fufu's line when coming to the rescue.</color>
Caesar_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color>.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
When <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

Clara_Talent_06_Desc_02:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"
XiaoZhao_Talent_02_Desc_02: Xiao'Zhao joined Krampus very early on, and even within the elite of the elite, the Krampus Compliance Authority, she's still addressed as "senior." That's how it should be... if only the juniors who came after weren't all the type who value personality over protocol.

Anbi_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Coils of electricity flickered over her fingertips.
Anby raised her head, eyes brimming with determination beyond her years.
Perhaps, one day, she will be the one with total mastery over electricity.
NangongYu_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>100</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>29%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>21%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> cannot be triggered for 8s.

While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>13.3%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.

When gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, every 1 excess point of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> once.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1471:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.

"Why did you choose to step onto the stage?"
Was it for the fans? For the glory under the spotlight? Or for that version of yourself who stayed in the corner, watching others play, too afraid to step forward?
Maybe it was all of those. Or maybe it was none of them.
All the girl knew was that the moment she gripped the microphone, her heartbeat would slow, and the world around her would fall quiet... until the drums kicked in, and the music rippled across the stage. In that split second, music's gentle light illuminated the time they all shared together.
It felt as if they were angels, with wings capable of carrying everyone away from "the here and now."

Grace is a technical expert at Belobog Industries. She's the core talent in developing and patenting Belobog's in-Hollow machinery.
She's obsessed with gears, metal and wires — a true mechanical geek. She's eager to dismantle and study any machinery or equipment she takes an interest in: "Such sharp and strong lines, truly beautiful... I can't help but want to open it up and take a look."

Grace always shows extraordinary patience when dealing with machines, doting on the sophisticated metal constructions as if they were her own children.
According to the information at hand, Grace is probably the only one who can playfully refer to Koleda as "Sweet Pea" without receiving a kick in the shin.
Question: Based on Grace's understanding of machines, would she consider me one? I'm currently lacking a physical form, however, so I don't possess components like gears, metal, or wires.

Cissia_Talent_02_Desc_02: If I can eat my fill there, it's a good place. If someone gives me food, they're a good person. That's the easiest and most dependable rule in the world. And also, omelet with rice is divine. Even that last leftover bit on the spoon.

<color=#959595>"I want to 3D print a model that's perfectly symmetrical from every angle. I just need to input the command, right?" —Alice, one minute before her W-Engine started billowing black smoke and shut down.</color>

Partner_ProfileDesc_1201:
Asaba Harumasa, a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.

He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.

Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.
Azural_Talent_06_Desc_02:
A sudden death is like a moment preserved in time, capturing truth in its final, immutable form.
I take these specimens from the hands of the dead, using their death certificates as the foundation for my judgments.
Pure, objective "truth" is the only rule I can depend on, the only thread guiding my way forward... until—
"Proxy, can I lie as well?"
Azural_Talent_03_Desc_02:
The Hollows are a vast tomb, where every echo of life falls silent within its pitch-black coffin.
But to me, it's a call I can never refuse, the final page of every diary, a memo of obsession and lingering resentment.
Even if... all that talk of letting go or holding on, they've got nothing to do with my own story.
"It's alright! I've talked with plenty of clients far harder to communicate with than you~!"
Item_Weapon_S_1491_Desc:
Music is the girl's weapon against the world. The moment she puts on her headphones, she becomes a tiny hero on a quest to conquer the "Kingdom of Unhappiness," proudly swinging her sword and shield and ordering the world to release the treasured fantasies it keeps stingily hidden away.
But... every campaign runs into unexpected trouble now and then. Like that old friend who disguises herself as an angel while secretly being an evil demon queen — why is she always able to catch Sunna slacking off in some corner?!
"Hey, I went through all that trouble to help you assemble that W-Engine, and you're using it to slack off here?"
Sadly, this demon queen of unhappiness is far too powerful, and her arguments are always airtight... Every time this happens, the hero Sunna can only put down her weapon and scurry back to the practice room, once again locked in a battle of wits with those complicated dance steps she never quite manages to get right.

<color=#959595>"One day, I'll defeat the Demon Queen!" —a certain hero who dares not reveal their name.</color>

Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.

Corin_UniqueSkill_04_Desc: After holding or tapping repeatedly, when Corin unleashes a continuous extended slash with her Chainsaw, the skill's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>28.1%</color>.
QingYi_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
When Qingyi enters combat, <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%.
When using her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
Lucia_Skill_Evade_Desc:

A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline when using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

Unagi_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
While in <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>, every 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> consumed will allow <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> ends.
When the slash for charge level three of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> hits an enemy under <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>, it will immediately remove the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1251:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.
Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1171:
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.

Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her, bringing them the same optimism she possesses.
"You like the drinks I mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!"
"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? It's suuuuper hot!"
NangongYu_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a charged attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>.
After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, if enough <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> are available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> do not interrupt the combo count of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.
Tsubaki_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash that deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Ellen_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:

Gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> upon striking an enemy.

QingYi_Talent_06_Desc_02:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"
SilverAnby_Skill_Special_Mark01_Desc:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color> mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414814: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>2.1</color>/s. When the equipper deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the Daze dealt by the equipper's attacks increases by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>43.5%</color> additional CRIT DMG for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this CRIT DMG boost effect can exist in the same squad.
Anbi_UniqueSkill_04_Desc: Launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Thunderbolt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> after the 3rd hit of Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> for an extra <color=#2BAD00>48%</color> Daze.

Item_Weapon_A_1271_Desc:
A defensive W-Engine independently researched and created by Public Security with special emphasis on enhancing the energy conversion ability in its shield. Rumor has it that this model of W-Engine became the standard for all supporting units in Hollow operations due to an unknown member of the top brass pushing for mass production.

<color=#959595>"Even if you took it apart and rebuilt it into an actual physical shield, it would still be extremely sturdy... but it really is super heavy!" —Seth, musing aloud as he studies the extremely expensive material of the W-Engine</color>
Nostradamus_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: The Hare Strikes Back!
BanYue_Talent_04_Desc_01: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> DMG increase by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> from the previous character in the squad.
Nostradamus_Talent_05_Desc_02: Though they have plenty of enemies in the industry, Nicole has led her team out of many impossible situations, and so their reputation and experience steadily grew.

When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> dealt by that attack increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.5%</color>. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

Partner_Impression_f_1041: Cats, super spicy noodles, going on missions, and everyone in Obol Squad... These are what make up Soldier 11's current life... I hope we one day hold a place in her heart as well~
Pulchra_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color>, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
Vivian_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"I will lay my true heart, like moonlight, to cover the path beneath your feet."
In chasing after you, she has already formed her own sky.
She is not one of vast love, nor does she have much.
But for you, only for you, she can spill moonlight, cover the darkness, and repair the fractures.
You are her only generosity, her greatest bravery.

QingYi_Talent_01_Desc_01: When Qingyi enters combat, <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. Weapon_TalentDes_81314205: The equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. Partner_ProfileDesc_1041:
Soldier 11 is a member of the New Eridu Defense Force.
She currently serves as a direct attacker in Obol squad, Obsidian Division. Soldier 11 is a code name — she gave up her real name long ago.

Soldier 11 is a fan of spicy food and likes the super-spicy noodles served at Waterfall Soup.
It's worth noting she currently calls us by a different name every time she greets us.

Longinus_Talent_04_Desc_01:

Weapon_TalentDes_81310101: Increases <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color>, their Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 8s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81415113: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>117</color>. Rina_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:

Unagi_Talent_02_Desc_01: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 30%. JaneDoe_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."
Lisa_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
When the 4th hit of Grace's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.
Weapon_TalentDes_81413803: CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>39%</color>. When the equipper lands a hit with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>13%</color>, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>26%</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300103: Whenever a squad member launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the equipper gains 1 Charge stack, stacking up to 3 times. Upon activating their own <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the equipper consumes all Charge stacks, and each stack increases the skill's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>19.5%</color>.
Jufufu_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Swing <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and 80 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lighter_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Seed_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>475</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>22.5%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>475</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>22.5%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>18.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
HugoVlad_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81311503: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>3.2%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Item_Weapon_S_1171_Desc:
Powered by a specially formulated fuel, this modified W-Engine is optimized to push combustion performance to the extreme. The engine operates by injecting fuel from the tank into the reaction chamber, where a high-pressure reaction device converts the fuel into searing flames, leaving behind a scorched aroma. It's rumored Nitro-Fuel can also be used as a power source, as there was a sighting of Burnice pouring one into the tank, and later scraping the remaining liquid back into a bar glass after the battle.

<color=#959595>"This is definitely slander from a competitor. The special drinks I serve to my customers are always clean and hygienic! The Nitro-Fuel that drains out from the tank is for my own consumption because the high-pressure concentration gives it a special taste!" — Burnice, in defense of her professional reputation, oblivious to her customers unconsciously taking a step back.</color>
Item_Weapon_S_1381_Desc:
If a storm subdued still has the power to save a certain person... The ringing of the old sword in its crate speaks of the "good" old days that one doesn't want to remember.

<color=#959595>"Nekomata, put it down. No, there's no secret... Nicole, please let me explain, she was the one who started it..." — Anby, just a typical day with the Cunning Hares.</color>
Tsubaki_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: When Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, her DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> for 6s.
Clara_UniqueSkill_06_Desc: When Piper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>, up to a maximum of 20 stacks, lasting for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>, Piper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>3.6%</color>.
PanYinhu_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"
Summer_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: When Sunna uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, all squad members deal <color=#FFFFFF>18%</color> increased DMG for 60s.
Tsubaki_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.
XiaoZhao_Talent_03_Desc_02: Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao.
Aria_Property_ChargeAttack_03_Co_Desc_Br: Charge Level Three Attack Daze Multiplier (Coordinated)
Tsubaki_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
HugoVlad_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Yuzuha_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
PanYinhu_Talent_01_Desc_01: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Depleted Qi</color>.
Astra_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"What is the 12-tone equal temperament?"
"12-tone equal temperament is a musical tuning system, just like how children have to line up, sounds need to be in order too."
"But sounds probably don't like lining up, just like children!"
—Astra Yao's music teacher, recalling when she was six.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1401:
Alice Thymefield, a new member of Spook Shack, is a young lady from the prestigious Thymefield family of New Eridu.

Alice has studied fencing and Ether science since childhood, showing exceptional talent in both fields. She currently attends Celestia School for Girls, a subsidiary of High Ambitions Academy, where she's a model student excelling in both academics and conduct. It is predicted that she will one day inherit the family business and become a next-generation Ether scholar of New Eridu.

She places extreme importance on order and patterns, showing an almost obsessive pursuit of symmetry in particular. This even affects her aesthetic judgment, making symmetry the primary criterion in determining whether something is beautiful or ugly.

Furthermore, she's easily frightened, with practically zero resistance to ghost stories and supernatural tales. Despite this, she seems to show considerable interest in encountering such phenomena. Suggestion: Master can use ghost stories as a topic of conversation with her. No matter how much she initially refuses, it is likely that she will eventually come closer to investigate.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414912: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.69</color>/s. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>14.3%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>11.5%</color> ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Norano_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Azural_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Welcome to the Cross-Department Customer Service Center!
Our motto is simple: always wear a smile, always greet every customer with passion~!
A smile... the one expression I once found hardest to fake. When did it become second nature to me?
"Hello there, darling~ How can I help you? Well~ not that I really can do anything for you!"
Weapon_TalentDes_81413901:
The Daze dealt by the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>28%</color>.
When using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Triggers once per use of a skill. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1081:
Billy Kid, an AI construct that has passed the forbidden fruit test, is essentially a self-aware machine. 
True to his name, despite having the appearance of a robot, he is quite childlike.
He's a big fan of the visual FX show "Starlight Knight" and wishes to be a hero like the main characters of the show. He often refers to himself as a Starlight Knight and imitates the lines in the show.
Such behavior appears to be only for comedic effect, however.
"Don't make me sound like an idiot! I'm obviously very smart!" — Billy.
SilverAnby_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lucy_Talent_04_Desc_02: Rules and ribs are made to be broken.
Aria_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign: When Aria attacks or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During <color=#FFFFFF>Moment of Delusion</color>, attacks and <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.
Weapon_TalentDes_81201504: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.4%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
Lucia_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Lucia is inside any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> always triggers a CRIT with <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
PanYinhu_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Harumasa_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Azural_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.
Anbi_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Anby uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300504: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>2.9%</color>, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Aokaku_Skill_Special_Flag_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> after <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color> activates a Special Attack as she retracts the flag, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> on using <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Frosted Banner</color> state. In the <color=#FFFFFF>Frosted Banner</color> state, she can unleash an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times.
Soukaku's weapon gains <color=#FFFFFF>Vortexes</color> in the following circumstances:
Gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> when launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>,
Gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> when launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>,
Gains 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> when launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>.
Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>22.5%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>17.5%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
Unagi_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Rina_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed.
The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.
XiaoZhao_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining <color=#2BAD00>1.1%</color> CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.
When Zhao activates her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> ends the existing instance before applying a new <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
When Zhao activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, all squad members' ATK increase by <color=#2BAD00>550</color> for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
YiXuan_UniqueSkill_06_Desc:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color> Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup</color>, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by <color=#2BAD00>55%</color>.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Seed_Skill_Normal_Robot_01_Desc:
After the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, hold or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> by holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>. This effect expires when <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> once.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Seth_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: When Seth uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage</color>, he gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>60</color>% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>75</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81314405: The equipper's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> for 5s.
BanYue_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Banyue has more than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, he automatically enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lighter_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.17%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>11.7%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.
SilverAnby_UniqueSkill_05_Desc: Soldier 0 - Anby's DMG against enemies with the <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color> mark increases by <color=#2BAD00>20.8%</color>. After an enemy is marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>, the CRIT DMG received from <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attacks is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300503: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>2.6%</color>, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Item_Weapon_S_1301_Desc:
While developing this W-Engine, Captain Magus stood nearby repeating, "Not hot enough, not intense enough," pushing the maker to keep raising the temperature — right up to the brink of the material's melting point. The poor craftsman had to endure Magus's grumbling, Orphie's apologies, and suffocating steam to get the job done. Finally, with a sharp whine from the pressure, the special W-Engine emerged from its hellish forge — refined through fire and hammering, and cooled with a roar rivaling its master.

<color=#959595>"Captain, why are you always so angry?"
"I'm a gun, Orphie. All that flows through my chamber is metal and gunpowder."
—For the first time, Orphie saw a trace of sorrow in the weapon she called "Captain."</color>
Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Heavy Frost
Ellen_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Ellen gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> effect, shortening the charging time of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.
Item_Weapon_S_1471_Desc:
The Vajra with unquenchable rage — surely there's more to their cruelty than this. The warrior as steadfast as a mountain — surely there's more to their purity than this. The ascetic with a heart of flame — surely there's more to their suffering than this.

<color=#959595>"The craftsman was really fixated on the design of the lion's head... He said all the anger and courage were hidden in those eyes."
—Banyue, who can't help but think the W-Engine looks a bit too much like himself.</color>
BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1151:
Lucy is currently in charge of outgoing business and managing boars for the Sons of Calydon.
Since her name is far too long and she doesn't want to be involved with her family, she refers to herself as just "Lucy" in the Outer Ring.
Her three boars are called Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and they're unceasingly loyal to her.
Though Lucy often speaks with a mixture of rough and elegant language, her actions subtly betray the marks of a proper education.
Lucy's family is incredibly wealthy. She grew up very privileged, with anything she could ever want within grasp... except for freedom.
After her Ether Aptitude test results came back high, Lucy decided she wanted to be a Hollow investigator, but her family disapproved. She was met with harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.
"Hmph! There's no chance I'll ever go back! If I'm found... then I can say goodbye to the stars and sky and I'll have to inherit the family business instead!"
Lucy is extremely competitive. She loves to win and hates losing.
Currently, the one who has given her the most bitter taste of defeat is Caesar, so Lucy keeps challenging Caesar to duels, losing then challenging again, challenging then losing again.
Rina_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Drusilla and Anastella can never agree on anything.
"Beating up the dummy in front" is an exception.
Yidhari_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>66%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.
