Partner_Impression_f_1291: Let's just say, the fact that Hugo hasn't gone off the deep end or become a sociopath is already quite the achievement.
Weapon_TalentDes_81413205: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>80%</color>. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color> allows the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to ignore <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Burnice_Skill_UpGrade_02_Desc:
If Burnice has <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color> hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, the counter no longer increases. Consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color> clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>480%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>240%</color>/<color=#FF5521>600%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>40%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>60%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>12%</color> of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
XiaoZhao_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:1+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.06,1,2}%</color> of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra</color> can trigger at most once every 30s.
QingYi_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
Upon entering or exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect</color> state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP.
If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
Brujas_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"
Evelyn_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.
Summer_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Item_Weapon_A_1061_Desc:
An enhanced W-Engine with a high rotation speed. Corin has integrated its shaft portion with a chainsaw to provide additional cutting power for her "cleaning" work. To ensure that her "cleaning" goes smoothly and to minimize the pain inflicted on her target, she has thoughtfully increased the rotation speed to the maximum.

<color=#959595>"Um... Don't worry, it won't hurt! Well... I mean, it will only hurt for a moment, and then it won't hurt anymore!" — Corin, attempting to comfort her opponent before attacking</color>
Ben_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.
Item_Weapon_S_1101_Desc:
This W-Engine is renowned for its ultra power. Modified by Koleda, its energy level has almost exceeded the safety limit. Although this W-Engine is entirely designed for damage output, and the Speedup and Blaze functions have been merged into one, this is precisely what Koleda wanted.

<color=#959595>"I've got a clear shot at your shins, you know? So you'd better think twice before saying I'm short, got it?" — Koleda, warning a rude business partner</color>
Weapon_TalentDes_81301902: When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>4.6%</color>, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81311103: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>65%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Item_Weapon_B_Common_05_Desc: A standardized W-Engine with balanced performance. Despite lacking any particular tendencies, it enhances its owner's and it's owner's teammates' combat effectiveness in all aspects. For novice explorers who have not figured out their preferred combat style, this W-Engine is an excellent choice.
Zhenzhen_Skill_QTE_P2_Title: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
Anbi_UniqueSkill_06_Desc: Launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Thunderbolt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> after the 3rd hit of Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> for an extra <color=#2BAD00>58.6%</color> Daze.
Nostradamus_Talent_06_Desc_02: A switch to higher quality ammo with better firepower and increased compressed Etheric Matter leads to higher damage, longer use duration... and higher costs.
PanYinhu_UniqueSkill_04_Desc: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike</color> hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Meridian Flow</color> effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to <color=#2BAD00>13.5%</color> of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.
Weapon_TalentDes_81400205: Whenever the equipper's attack triggers an Attribute Counter effect, all units' CRIT Rate against the struck enemy increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Item_Weapon_A_1011_Desc:
This customized W-Engine Core focuses on power storage and has been modified to enhance power storage functions. It can effectively boost Zap damage output for weapons, and is the gadget store owner's piece de resistance. Not long after, Anby made some tweaks based on user habits, but judging by how serious and careful she is while conducting each maintenance session, these are probably not the safest of modifications.

<color=#959595>"Weapons SHOULD be dangerous. If it can't shock me, then how is it going to shock the enemy?" — Anby's response while carefully performing maintenance</color>
Nostradamus_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: After hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Nicole can reload, enhancing her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>. When her enhanced bullets or Energy Field hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 3.5s.
Item_Weapon_A_1281_Desc:
This energy W-Engine, modded from spare parts of a truck's engine, converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous. It placed first in the internal Leaps and Bounds competition, surpassing many heavy-duty motorbikes and even a truck driven by Piper herself.

<color=#959595>"Too bad there's no way to carry cargo... Maybe we can hang it on the tusks?" — Piper, top-notch logistics driver</color>
Anton_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Continuously strikes enemies in front with heavy punches, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Azural_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a scissors attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Yuzuha_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
When Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief</color> hits an enemy, all squad members receive the <color=#FFFFFF>Tanuki Wish</color> effect.
<color=#FFFFFF>Tanuki Wish</color> grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>1,000</color>, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 2,500, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.
Weapon_TalentDes_81302003: When activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, the equipper's Daze inflicted on the target increases by <color=#2BAD00>9.2%</color>, and DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>9.2%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
QingYi_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, it applies 5 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>2.4</color>%. For each rush attack performed during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {CAL:5+5,1,2} stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color>. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> are reset.
BanYue_Skill_Evade_Taunt_Desc:
Rotate the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} in a half-circle and press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> and quickly execute the required inputs during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> to then follow up with the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lucia_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color>. If her <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> reaches 100 upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, using any <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and upgrades it to <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>11.7%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
Harumasa_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color>, and when Harumasa's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color>, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color> increases the CRIT DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> by <color=#2BAD00>7%</color>.
Partner_Impression_f_1161:
Didn't Lighter say that he'd faint at the sight of blood? And that's why he always keeps his shades on?
Can someone who faints at the sight of blood really be a Champion? And even fight underground boxing matches...?
Yidhari_Property_QTE_Desc_Stun_Space: Daze Multiplier in Ether Veil: Wellspring
Ben_Talent_03_Desc_02: Financial responsibility demands mastering cost-efficiency and utilizing every available resource to enhance both the team and oneself.
Jufufu_Skill_Rush_Spin_Desc:
After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move and deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is consumed, changing the DMG to <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and granting 25 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is 15.
When consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is above 100 points, 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> will be automatically consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>.
Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> to attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.
BanYue_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81411905: Increases <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. Upon hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 8s. When dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 15s. The duration of each effect is calculated separately.
QingYi_Skill_AssaultAid_Title: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
Weapon_TalentDes_81201404: When attacked, reduces the attacker's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> for 12s.
PanYinhu_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color> heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Backup Provisions</color> effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!</color>'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
Lycaon_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hold down <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Corin_UniqueSkill_05_Desc: After holding or tapping repeatedly, when Corin unleashes a continuous extended slash with her Chainsaw, the skill's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>31.2%</color>.
SilverAnby_Skill_Special_Mark01_Upgrade_:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Thunder Smite</color> DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary</color> will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This skill counts as an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lucy_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.
Lisa_Skill_OverloadState_Upgrade_Desc:
Activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> grants 25 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Pulse</color> (max 25 stacks). When gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Zap</color>, consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Pulse</color>.
After consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Pulse</color> to obtain 8 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Zap</color>, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>560%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>280%</color>/<color=#FF5521>700%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>50%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>70%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>28%</color> of the original Anomaly's DMG.
While in the Pulse state, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle</color> is unlocked.
NangongYu_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81311101: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
NangongYu_Talent_04_Desc_02: I've got a habit of giving Sunna the most dazzling position on stage, and leaving Aria the high note that cuts through the night sky. My "dream" was borrowed from them, but the resolve to protect what I borrowed belongs entirely to me.
Rina_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color>, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.
Item_Weapon_S_1091_Desc:
Slaughter is endless. Kill, conquer, the fate of the cursed, a restless forbidden power. Only between battles, when rushing to the next frontline, does the foxfire enjoy a brief reprieve in its shrine.
How many more corpses, how many more sacrifices, how many more calamities until we reach the void on the other side?
She needs no answer. At the peak of martial power, the stench of blood will freeze in the air before being breathed in. Once all evil is eradicated, the world will be able to enter peaceful slumber with the blade sealed.
Hail falls before the shrine, waking the wielder of this power. The blizzard is coming.

<color=#959595>"Perfect for training... If I could shrink to its size, that is." —Miyabi, muttering to herself as she gazes at the interior.</color>
BanYue_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
When Banyue hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, he inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state. In this state, enemies <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
While using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1011:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."
Lisa_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Anton suspected within the component Grace referred to as the "Electropulse Recycling Module," there was, in fact, an Ether hamster tirelessly generating energy around the clock.
"Can you equip my bro with one too?"
Yuzuha_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Anton_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a <color=#FFFFFF>Piledriver Attack</color> onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies within range.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81411602: Upon launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, the equipper's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>28.75%</color> for 8s. When the equipper launches and hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> to the target for 30s, stacking up to 20 times, repeated triggers reset the duration. When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> dealt by that attack increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.72%</color>. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
BanYue_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."
Anton_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 mixed attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
The 4th hit is a <color=#FFFFFF>Piledriver Attack</color>.
Anton_Talent_05_Desc_02: Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!
BanYue_Talent_06_Desc_01: At any time, when Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, he also gains <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. The <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> bonus from <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color> is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color>, Banyue deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> immediately after an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> also grants <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1221:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.
Item_Weapon_A_Common_15_Desc:
Art can save those drowning in life. Mortals gather together, music of different emotions collide, and the drying graffiti on the wall speaks of a thousand unique forms of agency.
Now, turn up the music until the soundwaves crash the Hollow. Even if Ethereals don't have ears, let's make them feel the power of humanity!

ZhuYuan_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Zhu Yuan is equipped with Ether bullets specially designed by Public Security, which cause irreversible corruption upon hitting the enemy.
This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...
BanYue_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> DMG increase by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color>.
Item_Weapon_S_1511_Desc:
The neon disco light's misty shimmer intertwined with a playful angel's delusions, twisting into colors too blurred to name. Like every desire that can turn fatal, unpredictable and dangerous, yet no one could quite bring themselves to refuse.

Even seeing through the obsession behind the delusion wasn't enough to resist the temptation of sinking into it.

"If you say it looks like an octopus sausage, I'll turn you into one." — The captain of the Angels of Delusion, eyes blazing as she glares at a certain squad member.
Pulchra_Talent_06_Desc_01: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's</color> DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Business Partner</color>'s <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect now also applies to all damage types, not just <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Yidhari_Talent_02_Desc_02:
In the darkness lay the girl's slumbering thoughts.
They were not innocent daydreams, nor carefree flights of fancy.
Her mind was fixed on the memories she had witnessed.
"What must I do? What must I bear?"
"Good thing it's me, and not someone else."
"I know how to deal with being alone... I think."
As she sifted through those pasts, the girl calmly accepted this heavy gift.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1321:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.
YiXuan_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"To master the mystic arts, diligent study and reflection are but the start — you must learn to maintain a pure mind, listening to the wind and watching the clouds."
"When you transcend self and world, your command of Ether grows ever stronger, almost without effort."
"As you persist, you'll be able to maintain inner poise through any trial, meeting any change with unshakable calm."

ZhuYuan_Talent_03_Desc_02: As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal.
Seed_Talent_05_Desc_02:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."
Item_Weapon_B_Common_12_Desc: A high-capacity W-Engine that features a built-in generator, allowing it to keep a stable storage of electrical power without any manual operation from the operator. As a result, it proves to be exceptionally used in battle as its electric current can stun tough enemies.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1421:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.
Anton_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a <color=#FFFFFF>Piledriver Attack</color> against enemies in a line in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Zhenzhen_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.

"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."

So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.

There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

Lighter_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.
Burnice_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>290%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1111:
Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
 Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?" 
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"
Unfortunately, I have not collected enough information on such occurrences and am not able to deliver further analysis.

Summer_Talent_05_Desc_02:
The stars were strung across the night like gas lamps lit at dusk.
She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.
The passengers were all adorable little creatures like cats, dogs, and bunnies, and the conductor was fluent in the languages of deep-sea fish and owls.
Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

HugoVlad_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color> hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>300</color>/<color=#2BAD00>900</color>.
When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by <color=#2BAD00>1,000%</color>. Additionally, the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>280%</color>; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>3,400%</color>.
After Hugo triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1341:
Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

Though she looks innocent and cute on the outside, she's actually sharp-minded, meticulous, and principled. She puts great importance on "value" and "equivalent exchange" — not in the sense of pricing things with money, but in analyzing someone's ability and potential, giving an objective and long-term assessment of the impact they can make.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

Though she rarely shows it openly, Zhao remains cautious toward kindness that comes without reason. It conflicts with her belief in "equivalent exchange," and she tends to assume the other person must have a deeper motive for offering help.
As such, when dealing with Zhao, it's best to focus on mutual benefit first. If you want to break through her defenses with sheer sincerity and goodwill, you'll be fighting an uphill battle.

There's also one piece of intel that can't be fully confirmed: Zhao loves vegetables and dislikes meat, but she seems to be pretending she enjoys meat as well.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1191:
Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.
Since her fighting style leads to high energy consumption, she always carries a lollipop in her mouth to ensure an adequate sugar intake.
While she frequently expresses her desire to change jobs due to the hassle, she genuinely values her companions at Victoria Housekeeping.

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.
Apart from her role as a maid at Victoria Housekeeping, Ellen spends a significant amount of time with her friends, leading an ordinary and contented student life.

Thoughts: As a multitasker, Ellen must balance her student life with her job at Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Perhaps this is one of the reasons why she often feels tired?

"Eve! I've just realized something huge — both you and {M#Wise}{F#Belle} are tall and slim!"

Astra beamed with joy, as if she had uncovered an earth-shattering secret.
Summer_Talent_03_Desc_02:
She has never before received praise from so many strangers.
"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

Lighter_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.5%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.

A custom stun W-Engine made for an Automaton referencing the combat style and abilities of one. Energy is stored within, then lashes outwards upon conversion. Partner_ProfileDesc_1051:
In addition to her role as an Agent, Yidhari doubles as both a Proxy, and a contributor for Spook Shack.
To most, she comes across as laid-back and leisurely, but according to records, it's less "laziness" than a shroud of nothingness, leaving her at odds with the world around her.
Perhaps to most people, this would seem like the usual quirk of someone absorbed in their craft. As a gifted writer of bizarre tales, Yidhari should be more prone than most to immersing herself in the worlds of her own imagination.
In truth, however, her unusual behavior stems more from the burden of her own abilities.
In the Hollows, she's exposed to vast torrents of information unimaginable to most, tangled with years upon years of memories that have amassed there. That crushing weight of countless pasts constantly batters her sense of reality, until even her emotions are gradually worn dull.
The fact that she can bear this burden, turn it into her own strength, and still live life in her own way — that's what sets Yidhari apart as gifted beyond others.

Item_Weapon_S_1461_Desc:
What is a "heart"?

What is the weight of life?

No matter how many machines she takes apart, no matter how many flowers she tends to, she still can't find the answer.

She programmed the W-Engine to mimic her heartbeat exactly, hoping it would lead her to an answer. But as the rhythm echoed, she slowly drifted to sleep. In her dreams, Seed Sr. came to life — with a heartbeat of his own — and once again responded to her wild, wandering questions, just like he used to...
Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.

<color=#959595>"Trigger's heartbeat is nice and steady. Soldier 11's is a bit fast. Orphie's picks up when the Captain scolds her, but it's kind of slow otherwise. As for you, Proxies~ Hmm, yours feels really intense?" —Seed, pressing an ear against the chests of the Phaethon siblings to listen to their heartbeats.</color>

Jufufu_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color> centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> effect: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>11.7%</color>, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, character <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>11.7%/23.3%</color>.
The <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tiger's Roar</color> state, Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>29.2</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81201303: When attacked, the equipper's DEF increases by <color=#2BAD00>26%</color> for 8s.
Vivian_Skill_AutoEvade_Desc:
When in the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state is entered.
Lucia_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color>. If her <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> reaches 100 upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and simultaneously activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, using any <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color> consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and upgrades it to <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> state, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>16.7%</color> for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> or she leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state.
Corin_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash attack at the cost of Energy if the attack connects.
Character is invulnerable during the spinning slash.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the extended slash, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Billy_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Pierces enemies in a large area in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Partner_Impression_f_1391: "The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might!" I didn't expect senior Fufu to have such a side... so adorable! Hm... why does this feel like something Wise would've said?
ZhuYuan_Skill_Rush_Pistol_Desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>Assault Mode</color>
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Uses handgun to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Lisa_Skill_Normal_Upgrade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move while attacking. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. If used after the 1st or 2nd hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> again resumes the combo from the 3rd or 4th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While Grace is launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo will not be interrupted by her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>.
Zhenzhen_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
With 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust</color> is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>. When this <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Lantern Wish</color>.
The last hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> deal 1,500% of ATK as additional <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81410701: The Shield value provided by the equipper increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, all squad members' DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> and Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Unagi_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lighter_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.33%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>13.3%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.
Lucy_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Longinus_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, increase that attack's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>40.8%</color>.
Astra_Skill_Normal_Singing_Perfect_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Brujas_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Corin_UniqueSkill_02_Desc: After holding or tapping repeatedly, when Corin unleashes a continuous extended slash with her Chainsaw, the skill's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>21.8%</color>.
Aria_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Ellen_Skill_Normal_Upgrade_01_Desc:
After the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, automatically launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color>, dealing multiple instances of <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> effect.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color> does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Alice_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> can be triggered.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Aria_Talent_05_Desc_02: I once saw a city swallowed by the Hollows, its order reshaped by Ether. Everything beautiful was consumed by darkness, sinking into the long river of time... like tears fading in the rain.
Burnice_Talent_04_Desc_01: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color> is increased by 1s.
Burnice_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"That Burnice, she's always so full of energy! Even right after waking up! I have no idea where she gets all that energy..."
"What's even scarier is that she can get everyone around her to be just as enthusiastic! It's almost like she's some kind of monster!"
"But... I don't really dislike it, to be honest..."
— From a boar manager who wishes to remain unnamed
OokumaMari_Talent_06_Desc_02:
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.
Nostradamus_UniqueSkill_06_Desc: After hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Nicole can reload, enhancing her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>. When her enhanced bullets or Energy Field hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>38%</color> for 3.5s.
Brujas_Talent_04_Desc_01: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
Weapon_TalentDes_81201502: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>8.2%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81415015: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>144</color>. When the equipper is an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color> character, and comes on-field or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG they trigger increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color>, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.
Zhenzhen_Skill_Special_P2_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and grounded, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
After this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> activates, it can be immediately followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81410202: Increases <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>. The equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>31.5%</color> when hitting the enemy from behind.
HugoVlad_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>, the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash</color>, or the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Elegy</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Tsubaki_Talent_02_Desc_01: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
Aria_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
When Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup RES</color>.
Additionally, when Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
Norano_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81312702: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.46</color>/s. The Anomaly Buildup of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> increase by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300402: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>13.8%</color> for 12s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81410904: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>72%</color>. When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, the equipper's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>29%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Weapon_TalentDes_81412205:
The equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> hit enemies suffering an Attribute Anomaly, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>115</color> for 15s.
When the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is greater than or equal to 375, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG inflicted by the equipper increases by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.
Aokaku_Skill_Rush_Enhance_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Frosted Banner</color> is active, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301503: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>7.8%</color> for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>7.8%</color>.
Anton_Talent_01_Desc_01: When <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color> hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
Caesar_Skill_Revenge_Desc: When Caesar triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, her impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:8+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*1,1,2}</color>% for 3s.
Lycaon_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Vivian_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"Vivian is a love poem written only for you."
"We have all the time in the world."
"So, please allow me to write the rest of my life as your footnotes."
Item_Weapon_S_1161_Desc:
A violent W-Engine that can ignite flames with a siphon. It deals simple and crude burn damage, encouraging relentless, bone-crushing follow-up attacks. Rumor has it that the liquid fluid within was once a secret weapon from an old civilization's empire that dominated naval warfare! The formula has long since been lost and recreating it is extremely difficult!

<color=#959595>"...Actually, all I said was that I wanted a backup lighter." —Lighter says as the user of this valuable fuel</color>
Weapon_TalentDes_81200602: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases all squad members' ATK by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
Burnice_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
When Burnice hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, it triggers an additional special <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
After hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, while the move is active, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, special <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effects, and <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG will ignore 25% of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>'s fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is <color=#FF5521>Burned</color>, trigger an additional instance of <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.
SilverAnby_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Yanagi_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
After Yanagi activates her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the DMG multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> is increased by <color=#2BAD00>208%</color> when any squad member applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect to an enemy, lasting 15s.
When her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, Yanagi's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> against the target is increased by <color=#2BAD00>16.6%</color> for 15s.
Zhenzhen_Skill_AssaultAid_P2_Desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81415215: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When the equipper consumes at least 20 Energy in a single instance, every 20 Energy consumed grants 3s of a buff: when dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, ignore <color=#2BAD00>42%</color> of the target's DEF. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 30s. When entering combat, gain 10s of this buff. While the equipper is not the active character, the duration no longer decreases.
OokumaMari_Talent_04_Desc_01: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> to use her Enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When her <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Natural Disaster</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Hammerquake</color> hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
Aokaku_Talent_01_Desc_01: When Soukaku triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Blade Banner</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Group Set Meal</color>, the buff duration is increased by 8s.
BanYue_Skill_Rush_Desc:
During a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81302004: When activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, the equipper's Daze inflicted on the target increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.2%</color>, and DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.2%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nostradamus_Skill_Branch_Desc: After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Nicole can reload, and her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> are enhanced, increasing the power of her bullets.
Item_Weapon_A_1131_Desc:
An intricate W-Engine developed by Section 6 and later modified using the technology of a certain martial arts clan. It can control Ether particles to form an energy field and boasts a terrifying appearance that can easily silence a crying child! If you are unfortunate enough to face its wicked stare, then just wait until it unfurls its fangs. What lies inside is... Don't laugh! This poor little thing really hurts when it hits you!

<color=#959595>"Hmm... Instead of a cool mask, I'd rather carry another lunchbox... I'll go ask Nagi if I can pack some snacks in it!" — Soukaku, excitedly running to the Section 6 office</color>
Unagi_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, she applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>875%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.
Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301305: ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>9.6</color>%, and DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>.
