Partner_Impression_f_1171: Burnice sure makes delicious drinks! No wonder she's famous in the Outer Ring.
Zhenzhen_Talent_03_Desc_02:
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.

"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."
PanYinhu_Talent_01_Desc_02:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.
Weapon_TalentDes_81415314: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>29%</color>. When the equipper launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, their <color=#F0D12B>Physical Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>14.5%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Pulchra_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Partner_Impression_f_1351: I don't think she's as dangerous as Fairy suggests. She seems pretty approachable. I mean, what harm could a little kitten cause?
Azural_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.8</color> for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color> for 8s.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> becomes <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> for 8s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> effect. While under <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> per second. When a heavy attack of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits enemies, she gains 7.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window using <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Welcome Mat</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Forward Call</color>, the next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. When an ally launches an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> this way, Dialyn consumes 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>.
With at least 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color>, when Dialyn hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> and doesn't trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window, she consumes 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> to forcibly trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> window. The next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> reaches 90 or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>. A maximum of 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> can be held at a time.
Yanagi_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Flowing through Tsukishiro Yanagi's veins is blood that isn't entirely her own. This blood once granted her new life in the face of despair, and with it, she gained certain special powers.
"But as you know, something that isn't mine... comes with a price."
JaneDoe_UniqueSkill_05_Desc: When Jane's attacks hit an enemy, it causes them to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, lasting for 10s. If any squad member triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state and causes the <color=#F0D12B>Flinch</color> effect, the <color=#F0D12B>Flinch</color> effect duration is extended by 5s. <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit against enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, with a base CRIT Rate of <color=#2BAD00>34%</color> and CRIT DMG of 50%. Each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency further increases this CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>0.14%</color>.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1261:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.
Vivian_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
Vivian's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> increases by 40%.
When triggering a Perfect Dodge during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz</color>'s dash, or using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem</color>, gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>.
Launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color>, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>. Each additional <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, consuming a maximum of 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>17.5%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
Caesar_Talent_04_Desc_01: When Caesar uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 3 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color>. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.

Norano_Talent_01_Desc_01: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.

However, this premise assumes that everyone can keep up with its signals instead of stepping on other members' toes...

JaneDoe_Talent_02_Desc_01: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, or when any squad member triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Gnawed</color> state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>116</color>, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1541:
Promeia, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, is primarily responsible for carrying out "executions."

Unlike the other Judges in Krampus, each with their own strong personalities, Promeia feels more like an iceberg lurking beneath the surface. Quiet and reserved, she seems to have no personal interests or hobbies.

For the majority within the TOPS Alliance, avoiding any involvement with her is a given. If their misdeeds are exposed and they end up under Krampus scrutiny, the first thing those anxious rulebreakers pray for is that Promeia won't be handling their case.

There's a rumor that circulates quietly within the company, but no one dares talk about it openly. Before joining the Krampus Compliance Authority, Promeia came from the infamous Sweepers, an Outer Ring group that served Calydon and specialized in eliminating "unstable elements."
Yanagi_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
After a thrust attack during her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state increases to 30s. While the state is active, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG increases by 20%.
The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Outstanding Adaptability</color> can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.
Alice_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign: When Alice uses a third-stage charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starfall Finale</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Victory State</color> for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Victory State</color> again refreshes the available trigger count.
Unagi_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Reciting poems during the heat of battle can regulate one's respiratory rhythm.
Whether it's her mindset or breathing, Miyabi always keeps calm.
Anbi_Talent_03_Desc_02: Run, slash, move like lightning. She is no amateur when it comes to Hollows—she's an expert.

Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

Partner_Impression_f_1271: Seth really is a feline Thiren! He's like a kitty magnet.
Weapon_TalentDes_81311203: Reduces DMG taken by <color=#2BAD00>9.5%</color>. After being attacked, the next attack to hit an enemy will trigger a critical hit and deal <color=#2BAD00>780%</color> of the equipper's DEF as additional DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 7.5s.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1031:
Database search: Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.
Summer_Talent_01_Desc_02:
It didn't matter if no one understood her. As long as she had music, that was enough. It didn't matter if no one ever talked to her first, either. She'd never expected them to anyway...
Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music.
"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.
Brujas_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When firing begins, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.
Norano_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.

After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.

JaneDoe_Talent_03_Desc_02:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"
Aokaku_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign:
When Soukaku's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, triggering up to once per second.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1391:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.

Lycaon_Talent_03_Desc_02: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf as "Brother" or "predecessor."

Partner_ProfileDesc_1451:
Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1361:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1461:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1301:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

BanYue_UniqueSkill_04_Desc:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.

When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> when parrying an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, and recover 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When he possesses at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state by using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue can no longer gain <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. After Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, he exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, remove all <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>.
When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>225</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>27%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>27%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>1,375%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>19%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.

During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 30s. Partner_ProfileDesc_1351:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

Zhenzhen_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.

"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."

Yidhari_Talent_01_Desc_02:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

Item_Weapon_S_1071_Desc:
A multi-functional W- Engine specially designed with a motorcycle tire as the foundation. It boasts rapid speed, ferocious tearing power, solid defense, unexpectedly low energy consumption, and a domineering appearance. Apparently, this was initially just a toy that Big Daddy made for Caesar to play with, but every time Caesar played with it, it would end up in tatters. As a result, Big Daddy spent years reinforcing and modifying it over a hundred times, eventually creating this superb piece of equipment that can function as a weapon, shield, wheel, and even a light source.

<color=#959595>"It was originally supposed to also function as a piano, with keys embedded around the edge of the tire! But after a few tries, it didn't work out well. After spinning it a few times, I couldn't tell the correct notes apart, so I had to dismantle it... Fortunately, it can still be used as a fan when it gets hot." — Caesar, playfully flicking the W-Engine tire with her finger, whipping up a gust of wind.</color>

BanYue_Talent_02_Desc_02:
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.

NangongYu_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>80</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>23%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>14%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.

Lighter_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:

When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.67%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>16.7%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.

The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1291:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.

Summer_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate, or during <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to quickly activate:
Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Before the heavy attack is executed, activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will cancel the existing instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique</color> can be used once each time Sunna enters the Angelic Chord-ination state.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414312: The equipper's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>22%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>28.7%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>28.7%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Yuzuha_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or successfully parrying an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jufufu_Skill_Rush_Spin_Title: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
Harumasa_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Trigger_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Tsubaki_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
OokumaMari_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Koleda has the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect, she can launch an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> after the 2nd hit, consuming the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect and dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When Koleda and Ben are deployed together, executing an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> will trigger a coordinated attack from both, further increasing the move's power;
Koleda is invulnerable during the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 4th hit and enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Item_Weapon_S_Common_02_Desc: A new supercomputing W-Engine, featuring cutting-edge integrated chips that dynamically monitor the battlefield and provide tactical analysis for its user. Furthermore, this W-Engine can serve as a portable console, allowing its user to play the most popular video games anytime, anywhere. However, it is not advisable to use the speakers while playing games... Especially not in Hollow areas frequented by Ethereals.
Billy_Talent_04_Desc_02:
These explosive bullets of Billy's own invention are incredibly lethal at close range.
Their performance far outstrips Billy's original intention of simply making them cooler.
Brujas_Talent_01_Desc_01: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
Seed_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Lucy_UniqueSkill_07_Desc: When Lucy uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for the guard boars is increased to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.
Summer_Talent_06_Desc_01:
When Sunna uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state for 8s.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, Sunna can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, its DMG being calculated using <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> Agent rules. If <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is triggered while Sunna has a <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> is immediately consumed, and <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Focused Creation!</color> state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
Item_Weapon_A_1111_Desc:
Originally a high-rev W-Engine, it has been modified by Anton with the most expensive rotary drill parts. These modifications allow the engine to temporarily exceed its output limits, enabling it to better serve Anton's "bro." When it comes to anything involving his "bro," Anton spares no expense.

<color=#959595>"Ben bought the materials, Grace helped with the modding, and the force was signed off by the president herself... Bro, the blessings of all Belobog are inside you. Let's do this!" — Anton muttering to himself the first time he starts it up</color>
Burnice_Talent_06_Desc_02:
It seems like no one has ever seen Burnice truly angry.
"Trust me, you don't want to see it."
— From a driver getting ready to sleep atop Steeltusk
Alice_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
With enough energy, and without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or when dragging it backwards, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Activating the skill can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and restores 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Tsubaki_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81310803: Increases the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> against the target by <color=#2BAD00>46.5%</color> for 8s upon hitting an enemy at least 6 meters away with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301504: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>8.7%</color> for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>8.7%</color>.
Pulchra_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
QingYi_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
XiaoZhao_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
The CRIT Rate buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Ideal Colleague</color> increases to 125% of the original value.
The extra DMG gained from charging during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.
Nostradamus_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Azural_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Performs a rapid dash followed by a slash attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300705: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>. When attacked, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for 12s.
Anton_UniqueSkill_07_Desc: When Anton uses his <color=#FFFFFF>Piledriver Attack</color>, the skill's DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color> and when he uses his <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color>, the skill's DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
Brujas_Talent_03_Desc_02:
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"
Ellen_Skill_Normal_02_03_Desc:
After the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>'s charged scissor strike, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, if Ellen has <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill consumes 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>.
After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Cissia_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Cissia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tongue Flick</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
ZhuYuan_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>, she receives the <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Afterglow</color> effect, and the Energy cost of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced by 30.
Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will consume <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Afterglow</color> and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot.
Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301603: When a squad member's HP is greater than or equal to 50%, they take <color=#2BAD00>9.7%</color> less DMG, and <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> less Miasma Contamination. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Jufufu_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> and 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Lisa_Skill_ExQTE_Upgrade_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Gains 8 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Zap</color> and 25 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Pulse</color> (max 25 stacks).
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Trigger_UniqueSkill_04_Desc: When Trigger's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> hits an enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by <color=#2BAD00>27.5%</color> for 5s. This Stun DMG Multiplier increase will apply even if the target isn't stunned.
Jufufu_Skill_Special_Title: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
Brujas_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20.8%</color>, and Aftershock DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>70.8%</color>.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by <color=#2BAD00>230</color>. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed <color=#2BAD00>580</color>. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.
Item_Weapon_B_Common_14_Desc: A functional W-Engine that specializes in energy conversion. It can analyze combat environments and generate special sounds to disrupt the enemy's attack. However, when facing a strong-willed enemy, you will still need to seize the right opportunity to attack. Luckily, most Ethereals lack the willpower to resist it.
Billy_Talent_01_Desc_01: When Billy hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.
Pulchra_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: Reduces Energy Cost of activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep</color> by 5.
Corin_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw attack's duration.
Vivian_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and gaining 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> during the skill.
Aria_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color>.
If Aria's 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>18.3%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>9.5%</color>/<color=#FF5521>23.8%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>1.67%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>2.4%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>0.9</color> per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
Aria_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweet Melody</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Delivers a quicker forward kick, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. If the attack hits an enemy, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> is generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
OokumaMari_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.
EquipmentSuit_31300_4_des: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, reduce the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to the equipper's Attribute by 20% for 8s. This effect does not stack with others of the same attribute.
Lisa_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Grace was personally involved in writing the "Belobog Industries' Construction Safety Guidelines."
She's also the employee who violated the "no dangerous explosives at construction sites" policy the most times.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414514: The equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.58</color>/s. When the equipper activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> or extends its duration, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>36.3%</color> increased DMG and <color=#2BAD00>21.8%</color> increased Max HP for 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Alice_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."
Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after using the 4th/5th attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Braced Bow</color> to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field, firing <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the target's <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> stacks are close to the maximum, fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Trigger_Talent_04_Desc_01: When Trigger enters or extends <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disconnect</color> upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301004: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>11.6%</color>. Increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>14.5%</color> when they are shielded.
Weapon_TalentDes_81400104: Increases ATK by <color=#2BAD00>10.8%</color>. Landing a critical hit on an enemy will inflict an additional 200% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>6.5</color>s.
Summer_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
After a series of hammer attacks, launches Bubblegum to cause an explosion, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in an area.
On activating the heavy attack, gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpeners</color>.
Upon landing the downward attack from above on an enemy, triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> and restores <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:-50+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*250,1,2}</color> HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Yuzuha_Skill_Normal_SuperSugar_Desc:
Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> will be attacked by a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> when hit with a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> initially deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.015,100,4}%</color>.
Yanagi_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, and switch the current stance.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, it activates <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance.
Block enemy attacks while <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color> is active.
Upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
Clara_UniqueSkill_05_Desc: When Piper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>, up to a maximum of 20 stacks, lasting for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color>, Piper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>3.3%</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414911: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.6</color>/s. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414002: The equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Mastery</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>69</color>. When inflicting <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>23%</color> for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, immediately gain 2 stacks.
Yidhari_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to <color=#2BAD00>58%</color>. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.
Lucy_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
When another squad member in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state hits an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK.
This will extend the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s.
The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state resets the stack count.
After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>.
Ellen_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, the obtained <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color> are increased to 3.
Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, the obtained <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color> are increased to 6.
For each <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
QingYi_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Its origin cannot be dated, its craftsmanship beyond record. From appearance alone, it seems to be a relic of the old capital, preserved to this day by the Ether burning within its core.
Many years later, the river washed it ashore on a shallow bank, where a young girl picked up the finely crafted toy. From then on, it stood in for her lost family, keeping her company each night, offering a small light in the dark.

Seed_Talent_01_Desc_02:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."

"The Starlight Knights never run from danger. That's what we call tactical repositioning for better aim!"
— User "Dreamgirl Monica" from the Starlight Radiance messageboards.

Zhenzhen_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.

"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."

Partner_ProfileDesc_1371:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.

They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.

The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.

Lucia_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.

A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with an enhanced motion monitoring feature, perfectly matching the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of Cat Thirens. Nekomata has added a foldable knife to its casing. Despite claiming that this design is to facilitate her in battle, the knife has fresh mackerel stains smeared onto it...

<color=#959595>"Lots of people call me a clever clogs for doing this mod, but when you're out on the streets, you gotta put everything you can to good use: Every little trick, every little thought, every little hustle... And look! A little kitty!" — Nekomata, diverting attention away while secretly trying to fish out the listener's wallet</color>

Partner_ProfileDesc_1411:
Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1331:
Vivian is a member of Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck.
It's said she can predict incoming misfortune through her tears, though there's no scientific proof of this ability.
A loyal follower of Phaethon. Ever since your original account went inactive on Inter-Knot, she's been trying to track you down — digging for clues, running intense searches across the network. However, Master, she didn't find anything... all thanks to my efforts in keeping your cybersecurity airtight.
Suggestion: Until her true intentions are clear, do not reveal your identity as Phaethon.
In case you've already let your identity slip, be sure to lock your doors and wear proper sleepwear before going to bed. Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1491:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"

The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

Partner_ProfileDesc_1521:
Cissia, a case specialist serving under the New Eridu Public Security Commissioner, is currently campaigning to become the new second-floor roommate at Random Play.

More than the danger of the mission itself, what she fears most is a call from her superior. The professionalism she shows in her actions is far more dependable than how she looks or the way she talks. Relying only on instinct and her senses, she can still make the right call.

She may claim to be a selfish, instinct-driven "bad guy," but the choices she makes often carry a faint glimmer of humanity beyond personal gain. She scoffs at order and justice, yet can become the sharpest blade in the hunt for the worst criminals.

But whether it's the lies she tells to protect herself, the fangs she shows when she bites back, or that wild philosophy of "survive and profit," Cissia has turned them all into a shield to protect the few things she still has. No matter what past or shackles she carries, she has already decided to make her stand here.

PanYinhu_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

Partner_ProfileDesc_1121:
Ben is the financial and asset management director at Belobog Heavy Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"I enjoy mathematics, but that doesn't stop me from giving thugs a good smack."
He's a burly and strong Thiren. Despite his tough exterior, he's of a surprisingly sensitive and detail-oriented nature, especially when it comes to numbers.
Originally a frontline mechanical operator at Belobog, his talents caught Koleda's discerning eye, leading to his promotion to a managerial position responsible for the company's finances.
Grateful for Koleda's trust in him, he remains profoundly loyal to her.
His favorite food is black caviar, but he dislikes fish.

I once witnessed this imposing figure seated in a small office chair, wearing small glasses, and carefully cross-referencing Belobog's asset records while mashing away at a calculator with his huge fingers.
Question: Is that what they call on Inter-Knot a "Kawaii Curveball?"

The soft hum of hidden strings and faint light blooming in the deep night, where sharpness and calm intertwine, transforming into a silent melody. Thread by thread, it captures everything held dear within.

<color=#959595>"This? It's just a device for storing instrument strings."
—Evelyn, gently strumming the strings. A low hum fills the air, and as the final note echoes, the enemy falls silent.</color>

Beneath the cold alloy scales, venom made of data flows. Each flick of the serpent's tongue probes the dark, carving out an electronic circuit that leads the homeless snake back to its "nest."

Each cycle of data in and out leaves untraceable fragments of corrupted code — much like its user, driven by instinct to chew through truth's rigid shell.

"It says... this time, the target's hiding somewhere nice and warm." — Cissia brushes a hand over the subtly warm serpent head, her smile hovering between danger and anticipation.
