Partner_ProfileDesc_1501:
Aria is the lead vocalist and center of the Angels of Delusion. Bright and full of energy, she always shines on stage, bringing warmth and strength to all Delulus.
She has a near-perfect voice, even though she was never professionally trained. At first, Aria only sang because she loved her idol, the retired songstress Cersea, copying her performances and singing along, until she realized she had a gift for song of her own.
Though Aria's vocal skills are undeniably professional, she lacks a solid foundation in dance. Even with dedicated practice, she can still get flustered when faced with more complex moves. Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.

This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

The art of acupoint is much like a chef in the kitchen. First, you explore the meridians, which is like rinsing the ingredients; then, you warm your palms, akin to heating the pan; and with two fingers pressing on the laughter point, the sound of laughter is like stir-frying. Practitioners must never recklessly strike a person's fatal point — it's like pouring hot oil into a stove, causing a disaster.

<color=#959595>"This little ball is darting between the acupoints, just like the fish balls I fling when making stir-fried noodles on the hot iron plate." —Pan Yinhu, distracted by random thoughts while doing acupoint memory training with a wooden panda sculpture.</color>

Partner_ProfileDesc_1131:
Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.
YiXuan_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Charge continuously, and release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.
Pulchra_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."

Item_Weapon_S_1411_Desc:
This compact mini W-Engine was just a budget unit issued for her first Hollow field training at school, but Yuzuha's kept it ever since — its compact size makes it too convenient to give up.
Her first modification boosted the W-Engine's power output. The second added two Ether-Anomaly-tuned components. The third attempted a rewiring of the internals, but caused a short circuit that burned a hole in her skirt. Manato helped with the fourth, repairing the heat conduction module damaged in the short circuit, though the meal she treated him to afterward cost enough to buy three new ones. The fifth upgrade installed a new resonance chamber, and the sixth improved its response to high-frequency signals from Drive Discs.
At last, it was perfect — a flawless, battle-ready device that could follow its owner through life and death! And yet—
"Dad, have you seen my W-Engine?"
"It's over there! I redid the casing for you. It looked way too ugly before! Can't have people thinking my daughter has no taste!"
"Dad! It's a W-Engine! You made it so flashy — what if it breaks?!"
"Well then, don't go doing stuff that could break it!"

"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"

Partner_ProfileDesc_1271:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> dealt by that attack increases by <color=#2BAD00>2.17%</color>. Partner_ProfileDesc_1021:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.

Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>175</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>21%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>21%</color> for 30s. The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.

The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"
Seth_UniqueSkill_06_Desc: When Seth uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage</color>, he gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>76%</color> of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>76</color>% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>95</color>.
Tsubaki_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: When Nekomata uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, her CRIT Rate increases by 7% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times, with each stack's duration being calculated separately.
PanYinhu_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
After an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Brujas_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>16.7%</color>, and Aftershock DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>56.7%</color>.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by <color=#2BAD00>180</color>. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed <color=#2BAD00>460</color>. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.
Trigger_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."
Weapon_TalentDes_81311104: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>72.5%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Zhenzhen_Talent_04_Desc_01: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is increased to a maximum of 200%.
Item_Weapon_B_Common_01_Desc: A W-Engine that prioritizes damage output over noise reduction. It can indiscriminately deal considerable damage to all units nearby. Its designer compares it to the full moon. Bright moonlight can interrupt people's sleep, and nothing can be done about it. But the moonlight does not bother anyone on purpose — you just have to get used to it.
Pulchra_Talent_06_Desc_02:
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.
Ben_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attacks before unleashing a forward strike, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Successfully blocking an attack enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to remain in the Blocking stance.
While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time.
After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time.
The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP.
When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value.
After activating the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Ben is invulnerable when activating Block.
Ben is invulnerable while launching strikes.
Seed_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> for the first two hits and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414712: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>23%</color>. When the equipper launches an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, their <color=#FF5521>Fire Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.35%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 20s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
QingYi_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Cissia_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Decidedness</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>, consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Decidedness</color>. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> that does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> does not cause Daze.
NangongYu_Talent_02_Desc_02: Tears are a valuable stage prop, but unfortunately, she's always been short on stock. Luckily, her acting skills as an idol are good enough to make them fall right on cue when needed... whether it's to comfort a real crybaby, or win a little sympathy from the audience.
Weapon_TalentDes_81412904: Increases CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>65.25%</color>. When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, the equipper gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Zero Death Sentence</color> effect for 3s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Zero Death Sentence</color> is active, the character ignores <color=#2BAD00>36.25%</color> of the enemy's DEF when landing a hit.
Weapon_TalentDes_81314203: The equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>32.5%</color>. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains <color=#2BAD00>2.6</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Weapon_TalentDes_81414612: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color>. When the equipper deals DMG with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>14.5%</color>, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG ignore <color=#2BAD00>23%</color> of enemy DEF.
Weapon_TalentDes_81201102: Accumulating Anomaly Buildup increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>28</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
Harumasa_UniqueSkill_07_Desc: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and when Harumasa's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color>, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color> increases the CRIT DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>.
Lucia_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Longinus_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Soldier 11's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> for the next 30s, up to 8 times.
BanYue_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."
Lycaon_UniqueSkill_05_Desc:
When Lycaon charges his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to completion, the attack deals <color=#2BAD00>66.6%</color> increased Daze.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG RES</color> decreases by 25% for 30s.
Norano_UniqueSkill_03_Desc:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, he accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, Manato enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato consumes 3.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> per second. When <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> is fully depleted, he exits <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> are enhanced, and he can use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall</color>.
When consuming HP during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes from an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>33.3%</color>, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>13.3%</color>.
YiXuan_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign:
After using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color>, gain a stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect.
While under this effect, you can ignore the <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Point</color> cost to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> once. The <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect ends after <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s.
Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> can be held.
Additionally, while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Meditation</color> state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
Aria_Property_ChargeAttack_01_Desc_Damag: Charge Level One Attack DMG Multiplier
Aria_UniqueSkill_07_Desc:
Aria's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>.
If Aria's 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>27.5%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>14.3%</color>/<color=#FF5521>35.7%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>2.5%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>3.6%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>1.4</color> per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by <color=#FFFFFF>50%</color>.
Longinus_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Corin_UniqueSkill_07_Desc: After holding or tapping repeatedly, when Corin unleashes a continuous extended slash with her Chainsaw, the skill's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>37.5%</color>.
Seth_UniqueSkill_07_Desc: When Seth uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage</color>, he gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>80%</color> of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>80</color>% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a <color=#FFFFFF>Shield of Firm Resolve</color> increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>100</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301003: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>10.4%</color>. Increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> when they are shielded.
Nostradamus_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Seth_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a series of upward attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Activating the move accumulates 75% <color=#FFFFFF>Resolve</color>, and grants 3 additional Assist Points.
After the move, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage</color>, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Zhenzhen_Skill_ExSP02_01_Property_Desc_D: 6 Qingming Sword Force Consumed DMG Multiplier
Weapon_TalentDes_81411403: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> increase by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Weapon_TalentDes_81300605: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color>.
Anbi_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: Launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Thunderbolt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> after the 3rd hit of Anby's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> for an extra <color=#2BAD00>42.6%</color> Daze.
Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Parry Counter</color>, with enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
When the skill is activated through <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, it cannot trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> again.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Aokaku_UniqueSkill_06_Desc: When Soukaku launches <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>, her ATK is increased by <color=#2BAD00>19%</color> of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> during <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assists</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Fly the Flag</color>, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.
Jufufu_Skill_Normal_Pot_Desc:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is 200.
HugoVlad_Talent_02_Desc_01: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color>, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
Azural_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
The amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> accumulated each second and gained when <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> hits an enemy increase by 16%.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmingly Positive</color> effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.
BanYue_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."
Weapon_TalentDes_81414913: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.78</color>/s. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>16.1%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
Trigger_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.
Norano_Talent_04_Desc_01: Max HP increases by 8%. During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color>, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
Unagi_Property_ChargeAttack_Desc_Dmg_02: Charge Level Two Slash DMG Multiplier
Alice_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
After any squad member inflicts a <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. If <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> is triggered while the enemy is suffering a <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, for every 1s of remaining <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> duration, the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG multiplier increases by 18%, up to a max of {CAL:18*10,1,2}%.
When Alice's attacks hit an enemy, she builds up <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. When she triggers an <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> through Anomaly Buildup, she gains 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> has a maximum of 300, with each 100 being 1 bar.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz</color> lands, it triggers a special <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect: <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>, dealing {CAL:0+100,1,2}% of the original <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Alice triggers <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy, her <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>14.6%</color> for 30s.
Azural_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
HugoVlad_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Justice, evil, madness, reason, charm, stubbornness.
He's composed of countless faces.
"So, which is the real you?"
"That's not important. How about, instead, you tell me, Lycaon—"
"What kind of person do you see in me?"
Norano_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Clara_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
JaneDoe_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Partner_Impression_f_1251: Why does Fairy only warn us once when it comes to Qingyi? She warned us to "remember our true identity" three whole times when she gave suggestions about Zhu Yuan!
Weapon_TalentDes_81300703: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. When attacked, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> for 12s.
Yuzuha_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s.
Enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG buff from her <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability</color> is increased to 130% of its original value.
Item_Weapon_S_1221_Desc:
A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions, precisely records the user's time active and physical state to calculate the best plan of action. Embedded within is Yanagi's prized watch, but each time the W-Engine is turned on, the hands of the clock face go whirling around from the Ether energy, and it can no longer be used to accurately tell time. So, when she uses the time on here to tell you that you should hurry and be more efficient if you don't want to be late completing your mission, don't believe her.

<color=#959595>"So you're saying this is the ultimate weapon against time? I see, as the watch in the W-Engine moves so fast, the time it goes past is 'killed' so to speak, therefore it's a weapon against time... However, time in the real world does not actually change from this. No matter how fast the watch goes, it cannot kill time faster. Though the concept is decent, this punchline is only a six out of ten in my eyes." —Tsukishiro Yanagi, replying to her colleague's off-hand joke with complete seriousness</color>
EquipmentSuit_31000_4_des: Landing a critical hit on an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> increases the equipper's ATK by 9% for 6s. The buff duration for different skills are calculated separately.
Partner_Impression_f_1151: Lucy's Knock Knock profile pic is soooo pretty! Is that what she looked like back when she was still living as a rich heiress?
Caesar_Skill_Counter_Title: Dodge Counter: Eye For an Eye
ZhuYuan_UniqueSkill_03_Desc: When Zhu Yuan is under <color=#FFFFFF>Suppressive Mode</color>, using <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color> increases her DMG by <color=#2BAD00>26.6%</color>. When attacking Stunned enemies, this DMG buff is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>26.6%</color>. When Zhu Yuan enters the battlefield, she immediately gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>.
Weapon_TalentDes_81411705: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.2</color>/s. When hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>7%</color>, stacking up to 10 times and lasting for 6s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. While off-field, the stack effect is doubled. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon obtaining the DMG increase effect, if the number of current stacks is greater than or equal to 5, then the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>100</color>. This Anomaly Proficiency increase does not stack and lasts for 6s.
Burnice_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Weapon_TalentDes_81301203: Upon launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20.8%</color> for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>26%</color>.
Vivian_Talent_02_Desc_02:
"If I had never seen the sun, I could have endured the darkness."
The word "savior" feels too heavy, and "good person" seems too light.
So, perhaps it's better to say, you were once her boatman.
In that storm called malice and self-regret, you were a ray of light, guiding her through the flood.
From that moment on, she could no longer bear the curse or the nightmares. She set out on a journey to find you.
Tsubaki_Talent_06_Desc_02:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens
Ellen_Talent_06_Desc_01: When Ellen uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or gains <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color>, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>The Feast Begins</color>, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>The Feast Begins</color>, using a Charged Scissors strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color> consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.
YiXuan_Talent_06_Desc_01: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade</color>, gain a stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Point</color> cost to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> once. The <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> effect ends after <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression</color> is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Regulated Breathing</color> can be held. Additionally, while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Meditation</color> state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
Alice_Talent_05_Desc_02:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"
Item_Weapon_S_1291_Desc:
A refined collector, a cunning phantom thief, a loathsome swindler, an arrogant, self-important bastard...
The world has a thousand identities for him. The elite despise his very presence, while the common folk hail him as a symbol of justice. In the alleys, they talk of him as a criminal legend walking the razor's edge. Among nobles, speaking of him is like lifting the lid of a cursed tomb.
He wears a thousand masks — yet none reveal who he truly is.

<color=#959595>"I'll live on in a thousand different tales." — Hugo</color>
QingYi_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign:
The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Eternal Seasons</color> increases to 135% of its original value.
When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Subjugation</color> she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
XiaoZhao_Skill_Rush_Desc:

Slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
HugoVlad_Talent_06_Desc_02:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."
Partner_Impression_f_1061:
Corin is excellent at her work, but why does she lack confidence in herself...?
If only I could share half of my confidence with her!
Zhenzhen_Skill_Normal_P2_InAir_03_Desc:
After the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> are consumed, granting the <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, which can be quickly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
NangongYu_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>70</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

Astra_Talent_06_Desc_02:
The turmoil in the world originates from the solitude of the human heart. If everyone's heart was reciprocated, perhaps all the suffering, sadness, and silence in the world would vanish?
If we could weave this connection with song, would all the cracks heal, and all the pain turn into a beautiful melody, filling the silence? At that point, the world would no longer be a lonely island.
"This song is dedicated to the world!"
Lighter_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."
Item_Weapon_B_Common_07_Desc: An energy-storage type W-Engine with a unique operation circuit. It will absorb scattered energy up to a certain amount before unleashing it, dealing some extra impact. Vivian_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
She is like a bird, flying from late autumn with excitement and anticipation, her wings sweeping across the winter snow. In the spring, she picks a flower and flies straight into the scorching sun of summer.
All because your eyes hide a thousand suns, she loves the fierce sunlight and fears no frost.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1101:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. 
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows. 
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1071:
Caesar: Leader of the Sons of Calydon biker gang and a "monarch" in the making.
Her combination of formidable strength and bold, straightforward personality has earned her the love and respect of the Outer Ring's residents.
Although she appears to do things in her own way, she is actually very willing to listen to others' opinions. Caesar actively listens to and implements any valid suggestion she hears — regardless of who it comes from.
She is completely defenseless against those she trusts. Once she accepts someone, she considers them part of her inner circle, treating them with absolute trust.
(Assumption: Caesar currently views you in this way.)

Caesar's father has been missing for as long as she can remember, and her mother passed away from illness when she was young. She was raised by Big Daddy, who took a very hands-off approach to raising her, allowing her to grow up freely and independently.

In addition, Caesar seems to have a curious interest in matters related to romance.
If you wish to get closer to her, you might want to try discussing this topic with her.

When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>1,250%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. Partner_ProfileDesc_1281:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.

After an hour spent enjoying extra spicy noodles, she decided to bring extra spicy revenge to her enemies.

<color=#959595>"I really like it. It's stable, efficient, and practical. The high temperature can clean the battle residue off my blade and even disinfect wounds when needed... Why are you sitting so far away?" — Soldier 11, introducing her W-Engine to her teammates</color>

Partner_ProfileDesc_1441:
Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.
Item_Weapon_S_1331_Desc:
Birds in flight, stars in the sky, blossoms, parasols, and swirling skirts — unspoken feelings, yet emotions laid bare. Only when the moon begins to sigh does the flower bud dare to bloom, releasing a joyous bird. It weaves through the stars, gathering glimmers of starlight, and before dawn breaks, it lands beneath your eaves... shaking off a night full of whispered love.

<color=#959595>"Lord Phaethon needs only Vivian. Lord Phaethon loves only Vivian. Lord Phaethon sees only Vivian... Chant that to it for 178 days, and you can give it to Lord Phaethon." — Vivian, fortune telling and voodoo are not scientific and offer no real value. Do not attempt them lightly</color>

Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1211:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.

Caesar_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"Big Daddy taught me that this is when you form a spearheaded formation with overwhelming force and strike at the enemy's weakest point—"
"And I'll be leading the charge, of course!"

"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.

"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."

When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. Item_Weapon_A_1351_Desc:
This W-Engine's design was originally much more modest. The focus during its creation was on offensive capability and stealth until its owner met a group of curious and loud individuals who had no concept of subtlety. Not only did they put flashy stickers on it, but after injuring their fingers, they often used it to cut ropes, open boxes, and even slice through sticky tape...
"That... yeah, that box cutter, lemme borrow it, thanks!" "Boss, it's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Hey, Kitty, lemme borrow your box cutter!" "It's not a box cutter, it's called Hidden Claw!" "Mind if lil ol me takes your box cutter for a mo?" "..."

<color=#959595>"Fine, it's a box cutter. Whatever makes you happy." — Pulchra</color>

Yidhari_Talent_05_Desc_02:
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."

Pulchra_Talent_04_Desc_02:
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

Lucia_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.

"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."

Watching the numbers bounce around in the account feels like a reassuring little game... until a problem shows up with no price tag attached. Fiddling with the stack of "chips" she's best at using makes the scale of "it's just business" start to wobble.

She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"
